name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Online insurance broker wholly owned by Rasan, a Saudi-listed fintech. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Rasan's shareholders with 5% or more are private funds and individuals per its IPO prospectus; none is a state or state fund, so the link to a state record fails (METHOD.md). Al Riyadh announced Tameeni as a sponsor on 28 Aug 2025 (riyadhclub.sa).
